description: Projects a view from another (IDrawingDoc.CreateUnfoldedViewAt3 with the parent selected): the parent's model seen from its left, right, above or below, drawn on the side the sheet's projection implies (third angle: the view from the right on the right; first angle: on the left) and aligned with the parent, as SOLIDWORKS aligns projected views. at (sheet mm) must be on that side and on the parent's centre line (its y for left and right, its x for above and below); beside the parent with a 20 mm gap when absent. Checked by measuring: a projected view of the parent, at the parent's scale, centred where asked within 0.01 mm, turned 90° from the parent toward that side and sharing its centre line (from both views' transforms), drawing the model's box projected and scaled within 0.01 mm; and the model is unchanged. Otherwise the view is deleted again (rolled back). Waits, changing nothing (busy, user_editing), while the user edits a view's sketch or the sheet format (sheet_format: true) or has a command open. After the user exits a view's sketch, SOLIDWORKS keeps that view activated and changes keep waiting until the user lets go of it: ask them to double-click the sheet outside every view.

document.description: The drawing: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

parent.description: The view to project from: a reference (r1.view.…) or its name (Drawing View1).

direction.description: Which side of the model the new view shows: left, right, above or below.

x.description: Mm to the right of the sheet's lower-left corner.

y.description: Mm above the sheet's lower-left corner.

at.description: Where its centre goes, sheet mm: on the side the sheet's projection implies, on the parent's centre line. Beside the parent when absent.
